content:
Folding screens develop more noticeable creases over time with use, but Apple's Kate Bergeron says the iPhone Duo's folding screen uses a replaceable protective layer that helps alleviate this issue.

The "protective layer" on the iPhone Duo's folding screen can be replaced over time, maintaining a like-new appearance.

After the iPhone Duo was unveiled last month, Apple executives sat down for an interview to explain how the company deliberately worked to improve durability and reduce the crease issues that plague other foldable phones.

As part of those efforts, the iPhone Duo appears to feature a unique design that ensures a "like new" experience even after years of use: a replaceable protective layer on the folding screen.

Here's Apple VP of Hardware Engineering Kate Bergeron speaking with TikTok account @angietutorials:

You can watch the full clip on TikTok.

Apple references this "protective layer" in the AppleCare estimated repair cost list for the iPhone Duo. As spotted by Quinn Nelson, replacing the protective layer costs $19 with AppleCare; pricing without AppleCare is not yet known.

So if you're worried about spending over $2,000 on an iPhone Duo only for the crease to become increasingly visible over time, it looks like Apple already has a solution in place.

Are you worried about crease issues on the iPhone Duo? Let us know in the comments.
